names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 5 марта ст. ст., name page 1663, «Онисий Усуровский (Исаврийский), мч.», with the grade word left off; the day's own line declines the bare forename and gives no place at all. Both toponymics are kept because both are part of the name the index carries, **and they contradict the life behind the same line**, which says he lived in Palestine. The gate's own `nameKeys` reports no folder holding the fold of this form, of the bare «Онисий», of `Onesius` or of this display name.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 марта ст. ст. — «Мч. Онисия (I).»

attestations.note: The only one of the day's ancient entries the corpus did not already hold. **The name is Онисий and not Онисим or Онисифор**, of which the corpus keeps eight and five; `.tmp/rusurn.py` finds no folder holding any form beginning Ониси but those thirteen, and none of them stands on this day. He is not named on the Greek, Romanian or Serbian 5 March, none of which the corpus holds him from.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes its line for 5 марта ст. ст. with (I) and gives no year; its life gives neither a year, a century nor a reign. The century is this one calendar's and no second source has been read for him.
